title: Ikigega cyahawe Uruzi
intro: Umuntu yahuye n'itegeko ridashoboka, aho ubuzima bw'umwana ukiri mu ruhinja bwari buri mu kaga. Bayobowe n'umwuka w'Imana, itegeko ry'agahinda ryarubahirijwe, maze ibanga ry'agaciro rishyirwa ku mugezi, ariko rigasubizwa mu buryo butari buteganijwe.
clues: Nabayeho mu gicucu cy'umunyagitugu wategekaga kwica abana b'abahungu bavutse.
Ubuhumekero bw'Imana bwaje kuri njye, buntegeka gukora igikorwa cy'agahinda kandi giteye agahinda.
Nashyize umwana wanjye w'agaciro mu gasanduku maze nyishyira ku ruzi rutemba.
Umutima wanjye wabaye ubusa, maze hafi yo guhishurira ibanga, ariko Allah yakomeje umugambi wanjye.
Nohereje umuntu wo gukurikira urugendo rw'umwana mu gihe umugezi watwaraga agasanduku.
Uwo mwana yabonetse mu rugo rw'umunyagitugu, amaherezo nongeye guhura n'umwana wanjye mba umurezi.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Yashyize umwana we mu gasanduku maze amushyira ku ruzi
Yasize umwana we ku muryango w'umusigiti
trial.answer: Yashyize umwana we mu gasanduku maze amushyira ku ruzi

location.label: Ikintu cy'ingenzi
options: Ameza ateretseho ibiryo biturutse mu ijuru

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yongeye guhura n'umwana we maze amwonsa
Yimukiye mu kindi gihugu maze aba mu buhungiro
outcome.answer: Yongeye guhura n'umwana we maze amwonsa

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
